Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
Reyda <re...@noos.fr> wrote in message
news:9cb369$11uh$1...@news4.isdnet.net...
> hi !

> Only one imortal grapple can be played each round.
> Watenda can cancel an immortal grapple per combat.
> Does it mean that Watenda with presence is immune to immortal grapple ?
> (i'll cancel that card. okay, i play strike combat ends)

Watenda is immune to Immortal Grapple whether or not you give him Presence.

Your opponent can only play one per combat, and you can cancel that one for
free (as it has no cost to play).

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist_W.html#Watenda

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist_I.html#Immortal_Grapple

Carpe Noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com
